lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: This is it, Chief. The printer just finished with the final proof. Grab the Master Portfolio folder from the desk!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: After all the editing and formatting... it all comes down to this. I'll grab the folder and take it straight to Mr. Reyes in the Admin Office.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good luck, Kiko! Don't let him intimidate you—our layout is solid!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Grab the folder from the desk and hurry to the Admin Office before the morning submission window closes!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Go make us proud at the Admin Office!
